title: Sordland/Turn03/Reformist Post Discussion
description: Discussion after reformist draft has been selected.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They read the changes and discussed..."
entries.dialogueText: They read the changes and discussed it amongst themselves.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After I made the final changes for..."
entries.dialogueText: After I made the final changes for the proposal, I showed it to my team.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Looks like the amendments are read..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looks like the amendments are ready to be proposed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian spoke afterwards."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian spoke afterwards.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. President, I understand that y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I understand that you're trying to save your skin by giving absolute immunity to presidents but isn't that going a bit too far?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""That contradicts the whole package..."
entries.dialogueText: "That contradicts the whole package. If this doesn't pass, it will be on you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Have a little faith, Mrs. Morgna.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a little faith, Mrs. Morgna."
entries.menuText: "Have a little faith, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I appreciate your comments but the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your comments but the decision is made."
entries.menuText: "I appreciate your comments but the decision is made."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will be the target of the Suprem..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be the target of the Supreme Court, I need this protection."
entries.menuText: "I will be the target of the Supreme Court, I need this protection."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. Rayne is not wrong.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Rayne is not wrong."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I will be doing my part, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be doing my part, Mr. President, don't think I won't. But I had to clarify my position."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But I have to say this too...""
entries.dialogueText: "But I have to say this too..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The new electoral threshold will b..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new electoral threshold will be really difficult for the party to accept. Our guys are not fond of that idea."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But I have to say this too...""
entries.dialogueText: "But I have to say this too..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Not reforming the minister laws wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not reforming the minister laws will be frowned upon by the party. The Assembly members have insisted on getting involved in the process."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's true. It will be tough to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's true. It will be tough to get all of their support. Some of our members may try to openly fight against this."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Not reforming the minister laws wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not reforming the minister laws will also be frowned upon by the party. The Assembly members have insisted on getting involved in the process."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm prepared to reconsider if it c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm prepared to reconsider if it comes to that."
entries.menuText: "I'm prepared to reconsider if it comes to that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will make sure the party follows..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will make sure the party follows me."
entries.menuText: "I will make sure the party follows me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll figure it out.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll figure it out."
entries.menuText: "We'll figure it out."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Any comments before we proceed?""
entries.dialogueText: "Any comments before we proceed?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We will all do our best to make it..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will all do our best to make it work, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Any other comments before we proce..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any other comments before we proceed?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I will say that I do not agree wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will say that I do not agree with the new law that gives the Assembly the power to impeach the Judges of the Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I am also against the Chief Justic..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am also against the Chief Justice and his obstructionist behaviour, but even if we get rid of all of them, the new Judges will be less independent with this law. They will be scared to go against the administration when it's needed."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""They need their protection to do t..."
entries.dialogueText: "They need their protection to do their job. Otherwise the new ones will be pawns just like Soll's Old Guards."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But it's more important that we ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it's more important that we get rid of the Old Guards, Mrs. Morgna. After the obstacles are gone, we can strive to make it better."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I will say that I do not agree wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will say that I do not agree with the changes to the Member of Honor law. I see that you're trying hard to get immunity and save your skin after your term, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""This law should have been abolishe..."
entries.dialogueText: "This law should have been abolished. It was made to protect Soll and now you're trying to give this to every president. This conflicts with our idea of 'democratic reforms', sir."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""What about the changes to the Memb..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about the changes to the Member of Honor law? I see that the President is trying very hard to get immunity and save his skin after his term."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I think I gotta say that removing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think I gotta say that removing the decrees was not the best choice."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It will significantly reduce the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will significantly reduce the powers of the president, especially in case of crises."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""However...""
entries.dialogueText: "However..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""As I said, I will have a target on..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said, I will have a target on my back, I need the immunity."
entries.menuText: "As I said, I will have a target on my back, I need the immunity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're reading too much into it, M..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're reading too much into it, Mrs. Morgna."
entries.menuText: "You're reading too much into it, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It seems we must learn to disagree.""
entries.dialogueText: "It seems we must learn to disagree."
entries.menuText: "It seems we must learn to disagree."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked a little angry."
entries.dialogueText: She looked a little angry.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Before we finish...""
entries.dialogueText: "Before we finish..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to me.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You have to be careful, Anton. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have to be careful, Anton. I'm sure you will be fine, but with all that's happening out there, we'll need to prepare against these threats one way or the other."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Looks like we can proceed immediat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looks like we can proceed immediately."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I don't think I have any problems..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think I have any problems with the changes."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Me neither.""
entries.dialogueText: "Me neither."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I appreciate the feedback, Petr.""
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate the feedback, Petr."
entries.menuText: "I appreciate the feedback, Petr."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The constitution hasn't changed ye..."
entries.dialogueText: "The constitution hasn't changed yet. We'll prepare until then."
entries.menuText: "The constitution hasn't changed yet. We'll prepare until then."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am aware.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am aware."
entries.menuText: "I am aware."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well, I think we can proceed now.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well, I think we can proceed now."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We will be working on the wording..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will be working on the wording of the proposal closely with our legal experts before we propose it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""In the meantime, you must introduc..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, you must introduce this proposal to our party."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You'll need to give a strong speec..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll need to give a strong speech to get them behind you. But I advise you to first talk to the leaders of both conservative and reformist wings of the party."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""As far as I'm aware, Mr. Clavin su..."
entries.dialogueText: "As far as I'm aware, Mr. Clavin supports the reforms already. Mrs. Tory will be the real problem. She became the real heavy-weight after we left for the executive."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will handle them.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will handle them."
entries.menuText: "I will handle them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Any advice for the speech?""
entries.dialogueText: "Any advice for the speech?"
entries.menuText: "Any advice for the speech?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Any advice in regards to dealing w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any advice in regards to dealing with them?"
entries.menuText: "Any advice in regards to dealing with them?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As Mr. Vectern said, Mr. Clavin wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As Mr. Vectern said, Mr. Clavin will probably be easier to persuade. We need to unite the party under this, so his support is vital."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mrs. Gloria will be tougher to bre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mrs. Gloria will be tougher to break. The problem is that she's capable of turning the moderates and the conservatives against us."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""As much as I don't want to say thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as I don't want to say this, if she makes demands to change the proposal, you may need to give in."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir, you are pretty well-versed in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, you are pretty well-versed in speeches. You know the party. Just make sure you get them hyped up about the reforms."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And don't show any weakness. You m..."
entries.dialogueText: "And don't show any weakness. You must also be prepared to reconsider the proposal if it comes to that."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Don't show any weakness, sir. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't show any weakness, sir. And be prepared to reconsider the proposal if it comes to that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for the advice.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the advice."
entries.menuText: "Thanks for the advice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will not give in.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will not give in."
entries.menuText: "I will not give in."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Understood.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood."
entries.menuText: "Understood."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We all shook hands and they left th..."
entries.dialogueText: We all shook hands and they left the room.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Wish you good luck with the party,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wish you good luck with the party, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I think we can end the meeting her..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we can end the meeting here."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Proceed all you like. I am not beh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Proceed all you like. I am not behind this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Aren't you changing your mind too..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aren't you changing your mind too quickly?"
entries.menuText: "Aren't you changing your mind too quickly?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's fine. We'll figure something..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine. We'll figure something out."
entries.menuText: "It's fine. We'll figure something out."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We need you, Mrs. Morgna. Don't be..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need you, Mrs. Morgna. Don't be like that."
entries.menuText: "We need you, Mrs. Morgna. Don't be like that."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""You already knew about my position..."
entries.dialogueText: "You already knew about my position, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I doubt that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt that."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""You should have listened to my adv..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should have listened to my advice, Mr. President..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Let's figure this out later, ladie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's figure this out later, ladies and gentlemen. The president has already made his decision. Let's move on."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I will personally work on the word..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will personally work on the wording of this proposal with my hand-picked legal experts."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""In the meantime, you must introduc..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the meantime, you must introduce this proposal to our party. You will need to get them to back us if we want it to pass the assembly."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""With Ms. Morgna's reputation as th..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Ms. Morgna's reputation as the most experienced attorney, this proposal will be bulletproof. Chief Justice Orso will have a hard time convincing others to oppose it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Sir, I advise you to first talk to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, I advise you to first talk to the leaders of both conservative and reformist wings of the party."
